pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the maddening global acoustic phenomenon known as The Hum... but when scientists analyzed the frequency data, they uncovered something terrifying. The relentless low-frequency drone vibrates at a near-constant nineteen hertz. That is not random noise. That exact frequency matches Earth's natural microseismic oscillations, specifically acoustic waves generated by crashing ocean waves interacting on the deep ocean floor. Essentially, our planet is acting as a gigantic, whispering drum, resonating through tectonic faults directly into human skulls. Declassified geological surveys reveal that certain geographical basins amplify these seismic waves, turning ordinary neighborhoods into acoustic hotspots. Even more chilling? Some acoustic physicists believe the signal is growing stronger every single year as global sea levels rise and ocean pressure shifts. The planet is literally speaking to us, and we cannot turn it off.
